concepts.name: Клякс
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished standalone character development sheet for the Blot AI assistant mascot KLYAKS. Use the supplied image as the visual identity reference. Extract ONLY character 1, the top-left ink-comma creature labelled 'Клякс'. Preserve its exact recognizable anatomy: graphite black asymmetrical flowing body, thick curved upper curl bending left, broad rounded face, tapering curled lower tip, large ivory expressive oval eyes with dark pupils, tiny detached black ink droplets as companion hands. Do not include any of the other five mascot species. Keep the same monochrome charcoal illustration with subtle soft shading and very fine paper grain, warm white background, gentle ground shadow, refined friendly personality for an adult productivity app. Landscape composition approximately 1536x1024. Left two thirds: one large beautifully resolved full-body main portrait, three-quarter view looking toward the right, curious and confident. Right third: three smaller full-body studies of THE SAME character stacked vertically: thoughtful with tilted curl and looking up, focused at work with lowered gaze and body stretching forward, delighted with closed smiling eyes and a light buoyant hop. The small detached droplets participate expressively. All four depictions must have consistent anatomy and eye design. Generous whitespace, no UI, no decorative frame, no additional objects, no tools, no other characters. Small clean restrained title at top left exactly 'КЛЯКС'. Small labels under the right studies exactly 'ДУМАЕТ', 'РАБОТАЕТ', 'ГОТОВО'. No additional text, no logos, no watermark. This is a static concept sheet suggesting future animation, not an animation.
